subject: Hosted-to-Dedicated: swap rehearsal, stress windows & acceptance gates
messages:

Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@pelagos.ai>

Subject: Hosted→Dedicated: next steps for sizing validation and swap windows

Thanks Marcus / Lauren —

Thanks for the rundown on the demo last week. We're ready to lock dates for the dedicated migration rehearsal and final swap. A few asks from our side so we can align procurement and our SRE on-call: 

- Can you confirm the stress window cadence (length + expected qps per window) you want us to run traffic for the rehearsal?
- We need the exact GPU profile (model/quantization) you plan to serve during the canary vs final cutover so our infra team can mirror it locally.
- What's the rollback plan / fallback model in case we see high error-rate regressions during the swap?

Samir will be our internal owner for acceptance testing. Our target: final swap week of Apr 9 (we'd prefer Apr 11-12 for minimal customer-facing impact).

Attaching our internal runbook draft. Happy to join a quick 30m to finalize.

—Jenna
Jenna Morales
Head of Platform
Pelagos.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted→Dedicated: next steps for sizing validation and swap windows

Thanks Jenna — good questions. High level plan below; I'll attach a compact checklist after.

1) Stress windows (rehearsal)
   - Two scheduled windows: 3 hours (low-latency profile) and 6 hours (throughput profile)
   - Target synthetic qps: 1200 p50 requests/min for the 3h window; 4000 req/min sustained for the 6h window with 95th pct latency SLAs
   - We'll seed traffic with a mix: 60% short chat prompts (<=128 tokens), 40% long-form generation (<=1024 tokens) to match your observed distribution

2) Hardware and model profile
   - Canary (rehearsal): 4x A100 40GB equivalent per zone, model: rwd-instruct-7b-q4 (int8-quant profile) with KV cache enabled
   - Final swap: 8x A100 80GB equivalent per zone, model: rwd-instruct-13b-q4_1; fallback variant: rwd-instruct-13b-q8_fallback
   - Connor will publish the exact container image tags and quant config in the runbook link

3) Rollback/fallback plan
   - Automatic traffic split: 10% canary -> 90% fallback if errors >2.5% over 5m window
   - Manual quiesce: ability to revert to Hosted API routing (no customer-visible code change) within 18 minutes (runbook test shows 12m median)

4) Acceptance gates (what you sign off)
   - Throughput sanity: sustain 85% of target qps for 1h with p95 latency <= 2.2x baseline
   - Error budget: <1% transient errors during stress window
   - Output quality: pass 95% of the golden prompt set (Samir will run)

Attachments: rehearsal-runbook.md (work-in-progress), stress-windows-traffic-model.csv (traffic profile).

Can we schedule the rehearsal week of Apr 2? That gives us one full week to iterate before your preferred swap week Apr 9. Lauren / Neha — can you confirm staffing for Apr 2 rehearsal?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

We can staff Apr 2 rehearsal. Proposed coverage: 
- 08:00–12:00 PDT: Marcus (SRE/ops lead), Neha (performance validation)
- 12:00–20:00 PDT: Lauren (swap orchestration), Connor (model/quant ops)
- On-call escalation: Platform Eng pager (primary) + Marcus (secondary)

A few clarifying notes: 
- For the canary image tag we'll use: rwd/serving:20280320-quant-13b-v2. Connor, please confirm the exact tag and we will pin it in the rehearsal runbook.
- During the 6h throughput window we'll enable KV prefetch for prompt classes marked as 'hot' — this reduces token generation latency but increases memory utilization by ~5% per instance. Neha — will watch memory headroom during the window.

I'll push a rehearsal timeline (to the Drive link) and invite Pelagos for a 30m sync on Mar 27 to align final traffic patterns.

—Lauren

Subject: Re: Hosted→Dedicated: next steps for sizing validation and swap windows

Quick pre-rehearsal notes from perf validation: 

- Local stress test (mirrored build) results attached: 80% p95 latency at 3200 req/min on 6x A100 80GB equiv with rwd-instruct-13b-q4_1 when KV prefetch disabled. With KV prefetch enabled we hit 4000 req/min but memory margin sits at ~12%.
- Recommended safety multiplier: reserve +20% headroom on instance count for the rehearsal. For your final swap target that means we will ask for an allocation plan of 10x A100-equivalent per zone during the first 6h throughput window; we will scale down after acceptance gates pass.
- Regression check: include the 'billing prompt set' in golden prompts — those are high-cost token traces that sometimes reveal generation truncation issues.

I'll publish a short checklist in the Drive doc (see related_links). Connor, please add the container tags & quantization flags in the top-level runbook before rehearsal.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
SRE Lead, Performance Validation, Redwood Inference
